tagline: Direct bookings, with an AI booking agent.

steps.text: StayFlow: direct bookings for hotels, resorts and rentals, with an AI booking agent.
steps.say: Stay Flow. Direct bookings for hotels, resorts and rentals, with an AI booking agent.

steps.title: Your own booking website
steps.text: Guests book on your own website, and see which rooms are free for their dates.

steps.title: Request a stay
steps.text: They send a request. Nothing is charged, and nothing is booked yet.

steps.title: Your AI booking agent
steps.text: Prefer to chat? The AI booking agent checks availability and prepares the request for you to approve.

rows.head: Any time, in their own words
Checks live availability
rows.sub: Quotes the total and prepares the stay request. The guest taps Send request.

rows.head: Nothing is booked until you approve

steps.title: Approve with one tap
steps.text: On your dashboard, check the dates and tap Approve.

steps.title: Booking page & downpayment
steps.text: Your guest's page shows the confirmed stay and how to pay the downpayment.

steps.title: No double bookings
steps.text: Same room, same dates? StayFlow stops it.
